answer: An escrowed deposit and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 40 POA and names its referrer, so 1,000 accounts pointing at one sponsor stand out like a dune ridge. Any peer can dispute an account with a signal of misbehavior; if confirmed, fake and sponsor are both slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, burned. A raven carries one message per flight; honest agents pay once and keep their share.
